(1na1)༄༅/ /ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i gtor bsngo bsdus pa pad+ma dkar pos mdzad pa'o/ /

tei:div.tei:p: (1na1)༄༅// ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i gtor bsngo bsdus pa pad+ma dkar pos mdzad pa'o//

(1ba2)༄༅// "$ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa dang rdo rje nag po chen po la phyag 'tshal lo// dam tshig dang ldan pa'i sgrub pa pos// phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i bla ma dang*// zhes pa'i skyabs su 'gro ba dang*// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams zhes pa'i sems bskyed pa gnyis sngon du 'gro bas/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan na ci ma rung snyam pa'i byams pa dang*/ sems can thams cad sdug bsngal dang bral na ci ma rung snyam pa'i snying rje dang*/ sems can thams cad bde ba de'ang rgyud brtan da ci ma rung snyam pa'i dga' ba dang*/ sems can thams cad yang dag pa'i lam la gnas na ci ma rung snyam pa'i btang snyoms gnas par bya'o// zhes tshar med pa bzhi bsgoms nas/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bha wa shud+dho da hūṃ/ bdag dang dngos po'i chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las ri rab kyi steng du sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan la/ rang nyid skad cig gis dpal 'khor lo sdom pa lhan cig skyes pa sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo'i snying ga mnan pa/ g.yon cung zad bskum pas 'jigs byed sngon po'i dpral ba mnan pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ mche ba cung zad gtsigs shing spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ nor bu dang*/ sna tshogs rdo rje dang*/ zla ba phyed pas mtshan pa'i ral pa'i thong cog can/ mi mgo skam po lngas dbu brgyan cing*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ rus pa'i phyag rgya drug gis brgyan cing*/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa'o// de'i pang na yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar mo/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ gcer bu skra grol zhing*/ thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang thod skam lnga bcu'i do shal can/

(2na3)rus pa'i phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang thod pas mtshan pa'i phyag g.yon pas yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud cing g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub steng gi nam mkhar 'phyar ba/ zhabs g.yas pa yab la 'khyud cing*/ g.yon yab dang lhan cig tu brkyang ba/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par gyur pa'i spyi bor pad zla'i gdan la bla ma mi bskyod pa'i gzugs can gyis dbu brgyan cing*/ thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ yig sngon pos mtshan par gyur/ thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros/ 'gro ba ma lus pa'i don byas/ tshur 'dus/ hūṃ la thim pas/ hūṃ la sngags kyis bskor bar gyur/ de lta bu'i 'khor lo sdom pa'i sku la dmigs te rgyun ci ring gi bar bsgom/ de las skyon sa bon gyi mthar/ oṃ hrīḥha ha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭaḥ ces pa'i sngags kyis bskor bar dmigs nas bhū tī'i bzlas pa la 'bad/ de las skyo na snod bcud kyi dngos po thams cad bcom ldan 'das la thim/ de bdag la/ de snying ga'i nyi ma sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa la/ de sa bon la/ de'ang rim pas thig le la/ de nā da la thim/ de ci yang mi dmigs pa 'od gsal ba'i ngang du gzhag go// de las skyon skad cig gis 'khor lo sdom pa lhan cig skyes pa'i skur langs par bya'o// de'i mdun du/ dur khrod kyi sa gzhi 'jigs su rung ba'i dbus su/ pad+ma dang nyi ma ro skam rlon gyi gdan la skad cig gis/ dpal rdo rje nag po ye shes kyi mgon po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ sku mdog mthing nag rngam zhing 'tshor ba/ ba spu'i bu ga nas rdo rje'i rdul phra mo dang sprul pa'i khro chung mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs pa 'phro ba/ khros pa'i spyan gsum me stag gi phung po ltar dmar ba/ zhal gdangs shing ha hā dang*/ hūṃ hūṃ dang*/ phaṭa phaṭa la sogs pa'i sgra sgrog pa/ mche ba zla tshes lta bu rnam par gtsigs shing*/

ljags rab tu (2ba4)'dril ba/ dbu skra dang smin mad mar ser gyen du 'khyil ba/ phyag g.yas kyi dang po na bai tsa'i 'bras bu mdog dbyibs snying 'dra ba 'dzin cing*/ 'og man ro langs kyi lce las grub pa'i ral gri 'bar ba gdengs nas 'dzin pa/ g.yon gyi dang po na lha ma srin gyi thod pa bdud bzhi'i khrag gis bkang nas thugs kar 'dzin cing*/ 'og ma kha ṭ+wāṃ rtse gsum dar dbyangs ḍa ma ru dang ldan pa 'phyar stabs su 'dzin pa/ stag lpags rlon pa'i sham thabs kyis smad dkris shing*/ bdud btul ba'i rus pa'i rgyan drug gis mdzes par brgyan pa/ mi mgo skam po lngas dbu brgyan cing*/ rlon pa khrag 'dzeg pa lnga bcu'i do shal 'phyang ba/ sprul dkar pos dbu brgyan/ dmar pos snyan brgyan/ ser khras mgul brgyan/ nag pos zhabs gdul/ ljang khras phyag gdug sngo khras me ral kha/ smug nag gis ska rags/ thal skyas lhu tshigs brgyan pa/ dar dpyangs kyi cod pan 'tshang zhing*/ khrag gi thig le/ zhag gi zo ris/ thal chen gyi tshom bu la sogs pas spras pa/ zhabs g.yas cung zad bskum pas pad nyi dang ro skam rlon gyi steng du 'gying bag dang bcas te bzhugs shing gzi brjid dang ldan pa/ de'i g.yas su/ las mgon bya rog gi gdong can/ sku mdog nag po rab tu rngam pa'i gzugs can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ khros shing rgan sgra dang bcas pa'i zhabs brdabs pas srid gsum g.yo ba/ g.yas gri gug dang*/ g.yon thod pa dgra bgegs kyi snying gis gang ba 'dzin pa/ mi mgo'i 'phreng ba dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ stag lpags rlon pa'i sham thab can/ 'jigs su rung ba'i zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bas ro'i gdan bzhugs pa/ g.yon du dpal ldan lha mo nag mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi/ mche ba gtsigs shing spyan gsum dmar la zlum pa/ khro gnyer dpral bar bsdus shing lan bu gyen du (3na5)'khyil nas sa la 'drud pa/ thod skam lngas dbu la brgyan cing*/

thod rlon gyi do shal 'phyang ba/ phyag g.yas ral gri dang tri shu la/ g.yon mda' gzhu dang dgra mgo 'dzin pa/ stag lpags kyis smad dkris shing*/ zhabs gnyis phyed skyil gyis dre'u'i stengs na bzhugs pa/ mkha' 'gro brgyad/ sha za srin po la sogs pa'i las mkhan/ ro langs brgya/ nag po stong*/ sha za 'bum/ ma mo bye ba/ gnod sbyin khri la sogs pas bskor ba'i gtso 'khor thams cad kyi sri bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥthugs kar hūṃ/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥye shes pa dang dam tshig pa dbyer med du bsres nas/ oṃ shrī badz+ra mahā kā las ri wā ra bh+ya ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tshi swāhā/ de bzhin du/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ shap+ta/ rū pa/ wi ni/ rā s+ya/ spa r+she/ pañtsa a mṛ ta pū dza khā hi/ de nas gtor ma swa bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang lam/ kaṃ las mi mgo'i sgyed bu gsum gyi steng du a yig dkar po las byung ba'i thod pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ gtor rdzas rnams sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga'i rang bzhin oṃ āḥhūṃ ha ho hrīḥzag pa med pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor byin gyis brlabs nas/ oṃ badz+ra ka wu wa pa mahā kā lā ya hūṃ phaṭa/ i dam ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ oṃ shrī ya de wi kā li mahā kā li hūṃ bh+yo i daṃ */ oṃ kar+m+ma mahā kā la gu ṇa hri da i daṃ */ oṃ mahā kā la/ shā sa no pa ka ri ṇe/ pash+tsi ma ka lo ya i daṃ rat+na tra yā pa kā re ṇaṃ/ ya ti pra tī dz+nyāṃ/ sma ra si ta dā/ i daṃ ba liṃ kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ sarba duṣ+ṭa sa twa na// ma ra ma ra/ gṛ h+ṇa gṛ h+ṇa/ ban+dha ban+dha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ di na me ke na mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa hūṃ/ lan bdun (3ba6)nam/ nyer gcig gis 'bul lo// 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ rkang pa brgyad pas bstod/ man ngag ltar bzlas nas/

mchod bstod bsdus pa tsam byas nas/ mdun bskyed kyi gtso 'khor rnams dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa dbyer med du gyur pa/ rang gi thugs kar bstim la/ de kho na nyid kyi don la mnyam par bzhag /de las skyo na/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /ye shes mgon po 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// khyed kyis la 'dod par shog /ces sogs kyi bsngo ba dang bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa rgya cher brjod/// /chos sbyin rgya cher spel ba'i ched/ par bzhengs glegs bu re re la// dngul krang yon 'gyed mdzad po ni// chos rgyal bsod nams rgyal mtshan no/// /
